subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Rounding Road
objective: Round whole numbers using nearest benchmarks.
introduction: Milo is rolling a ball toward the tens and hundreds marks! Help him round 47, 342, and 3,620.

vocabulary.definition: To change a number to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand.
A symbol or word that tells how many, like 47.
A group of ten ones, like the ten that 47 rounds to.

activities.content: Locate the number between two multiples and choose the nearer benchmark; an exact midpoint rounds to the stated convention.

items.explanation: 47 is between 40 and 50. The ones digit is 7, and 5 or more rounds up, so 47 rounds to 50.
47 has 7 ones, and 7 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 50.

items.prompt: Which is NOT how rounding works?
items.explanation: Rounding changes a number to a nearby friendly number. Keeping every digit unchanged is not rounding.
The ones digit is 7, and 5 or more rounds up, so 47 rounds to 50.
3,620 has 6 hundreds, and 5 or more rounds up, so it rounds to 4,000.
